topic.title: Capacity allocation and measured prediction cost
topic.question: Under the frozen inputs and training protocol, can reducing or reallocating representation and interaction capacity preserve the stronger source click AUC while reducing parameter count and measured inference cost?
topic.hypothesis: The stronger source may have reducible or unevenly useful capacity. Starting from its frozen best, simple capacity reductions and matched-parameter reallocations should identify a smaller, faster configuration that preserves click AUC. Compare against the unchanged source and shared baseline under the same protocol; use replacement controls, matched training exposure, measured training and inference cost, and repetitions before claiming robust retention. Consistent AUC loss under capacity reduction, or an advantage explained by additional capacity or compute, would falsify the proposed efficiency benefit within the tested range. The compact summaries do not identify which components are redundant; component choices require inspection in the implementation phase.
